REFLECTION.5_escaped_failure_modes: (a) shared_ref_neutralises=0.0 and both_neutral=0.0 exactly -- the 2x2 is balanced (content still registers +0.40/+0.68 when position is clean), so position dominance is NOT an artifact of position-neutralization being merely more destructive. (c) The window is 4 tokens so 'content' = local only; the floor=0 makes this scope explicit and testable, not hidden. (d) primary-arm distance confound present and reported; the distance-matched secondary arm shows the SAME position dominance, so it is not merely distance-decay.
REFLECTION.overall: L3H1's donor-query acceptor-targeting DIFFERENCE (S_A) is dominated by POSITIONAL GEOMETRY (absolute position embeddings), not local sequence content, and lives entirely within the 4-token key window (floor=0). Combined with A0 (difference embedding-resident, not layer-constructed; query pathway adds class-level gain), the mechanism of L3H1's attention targeting is positional -- consistent with C8 and the R15 position-is-in-the-vector lesson, and it materially weakens C20's content/identity reading of the QK/attention preference. The behaviour-level partner-specificity (C19) is untouched and now poses the key synthesis question: how positional targeting + the U_info readout produce partner-SPECIFIC coupling. Next: a distance/geometry intervention, and a C19<->A1a reconciliation.
